canonical_style: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset for TEXTOPIA, an original cozy personal reading-village game for ages 10-12. CAMERA LOCK: orthographic parallel projection, camera 45 degrees around the object and 35 degrees above ground, looking down at a fixed three-quarter angle. prompts.map-ground: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one reusable rectangular LANDSCAPE background at 1536x1024 for TEXTOPIA, a fixed-camera 2.5D book village. This is ONLY THE GROUND LAYER with no tall objects. Orthographic parallel-projection world seen at 35-degree elevation above the horizontal, 45-degree camera azimuth. No sky, no horizon, no distant scenery, no perspective shrinkage. Continuous warm sage and moss-green meadow fills every edge, NO floating island, NO cutout board edge. A shallow small blue-green pond occupying the upper-right corner around x=83 percent y=22 percent, no rocks taller than a tiny flat shore pebble. A narrow warm cream packed-earth path begins at bottom-center, gently curves through center-left and branches toward broad EMPTY grassy sites in upper-left and middle-right; it should feel like a natural strolling path, not a street network and not a full circular ring. Leave large clear areas around x=28percent y=36percent, x=68percent y=57percent, x=45percent y=76percent for future houses, WITHOUT any grid, dirt building plots, house-shaped markings, visible placeholder circles, or labels. At least 75 percent clean softly varied grass, readable spacious composition, peripheral low grass flecks only. Surface textures very subtle and low-frequency, soft matte hand-painted 2.5D casual-game look that fits rounded clay sprites. Uniform light from upper-left. No buildings, trees, bushes, flowers, benches, signs, fence, characters, objects, UI, logos, text, or cast shadows. Keep the ground rich but quiet so separate PNG props will read well.

prompts.map-arrangement-reference:

Preserve its rectangular framing, path network, pond, ground colors and empty spaces as closely as possible. Images 2-5 are style/prop references: sage book cottage, tree, sentence frame, and reading bench. Do NOT show any inventory sheet, grid, white border or labels.
Use a fixed orthographic 2.5D viewpoint consistent with the provided objects. Place THREE SMALL book cottages of the identical design with green, terracotta and blue roof variants, each cottage only about 14 percent of image width, not a hero house. ALL objects visibly seated at ground height, with restrained soft shadows to lower-right, no floating objects, no huge foreground furniture, no extra architecture.
